rubric: Repeating init after adding project-specific content to the installed AGENTS.md silently overwrites that content with the framework policy while reporting preserve-edit, with no backup of the lost content.
trigger: Run init --target ./project --json, append a unique project policy to project/AGENTS.md, then repeat the same init command and inspect AGENTS.md and .oaw/backups.
user_impact: A routine repeat installation permanently removes the user's project-specific policy edits without consent. The successful result claims the edit was preserved, and init creates no recovery backup.
intended_lookalikes: A normal repeat init with no local edits succeeds without changing installed content.
Doctor may warn about edited managed content while still exiting successfully.
A pre-existing conflicting policy in a project that OAW has never managed makes init refuse without writing.
migrate is a preview unless --apply is supplied; acknowledged custom files are project-owned.
